title: PublicTrustReceipt
description: Public-facing trust receipt attached to every FinalEvidenceContract for apps_underwriting_ai. Carries governed metadata about the underwriting decision pass. All applicant data is synthetic. Plan: apps-underwriting-ai-deferred-scope-e8b2f4 D5.1.

route_family.description: Route family used for this decision (e.g. R3R4_MANAGED_WORKFLOW).

underwriting_route_mode.description: Mode within the route family (e.g. FULL_DECISION_PACKET).

documents_received_count.description: Total synthetic documents received from the applicant.

documents_missing_count.description: Count of required document classes absent from the submission.

contradiction_flags_count.description: Number of contradiction flags raised by the C0 adapter.

demo_scorer_version.description: Version tag of the DeterministicRiskScorer used.

demo_policy_hash.description: Policy hash bound to this run (empty string when not available).

replay_key_prefix.description: First 12 chars of the R1A replay key (empty when not a replay).

exit_disposition.description: Exit X3 disposition class emitted for this run.

hitl_posture.description: HITL posture resolved by the L3 adapter.

generated_rationale_used.description: True when the LLM rationale was accepted by the firewall.

deterministic_rationale_fallback_used.description: True when the firewall fell back to the deterministic rationale.

demo_packet_id.description: Unique ID for this decision packet instance.

demo_mode.description: Always true — this app produces synthetic demo packets only.
